description: Says what Piqline (a monitoring platform that reads any public source, dates what it sees and alerts teams) can do for a given business: six concrete uses ranked by value (new clients, hiring, competitors, content…), the technologies behind each, and first requests to try. Give a profession, a company, a website (its public pages are read) or a use case. Describes how Piqline works for that business; it returns no live data. Answers in French by default.
